corrected_or_refuted.false_statement: SDP(A) >= n sqrt(n-1) for every Seidel A
corrected_or_refuted.correction: Only the two-sided maximum has the universal floor; the order-5 counterexample has SDP(A)=9 exactly.

corrected_or_refuted.false_statement: A tensor expression of the form A tensor B + I tensor S is automatically Seidel
corrected_or_refuted.correction: Some off-diagonal entries can be zero.
The row-sum eigenvalue must also have extremal magnitude.

corrected_or_refuted.false_statement: The single-split route is rigorously capped at approximately 0.335
corrected_or_refuted.correction: 0.335 is numerical; the proved ceiling is 2/(3 sqrt(3)).
An analytic oscillating comparison sequence satisfies the same one-sided structural properties.

corrected_or_refuted.false_statement: Dense low-degree Fourier mass plus subset robustness forces sqrt(p) moment growth
corrected_or_refuted.correction: A constant-modulus symmetric construction satisfies those summaries with all Lp norms equal.
